title: Results: Enforcing Document Permissions in Vector Search, an Experimental Comparison
description: The measured runs of the study whose plan was deposited before any of them at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24026269 (release prereg-v1 of this repository). This version holds the raw outputs of all 180 measured jobs (three seeds of every cell; W3 as one job per readable share), the report that the pre-registered analysis (bench.report) made from them, the figures (bench.figures), and the harness at the commit that made them. report/collected.tsv lists every job with its workflow run; SHA256SUMS covers both archives. The raw outputs hold identifiers, scores, timings and plan shapes, not passage or message text; the workloads they refer to are the releases data-msmarco-v1 (derived from MS MARCO, non-commercial research only under its terms) and data-enron-v2 (derived from the CMU Enron corpus) of the repository. Code and history: https://github.com/muzakkirhussain011/rag-permission-bench. The study includes wardowl, the author's own library, as one arm; this is a declared conflict of interest.
